slides.voice_text: DUP Market Radar is a hybrid Python and Rust watchlist built for the crypto market. It tracks spot, watch-only futures, memes, stablecoins, and new listings. Manual orders and optional auto-execution run strictly on KuCoin spot.

slides.voice_text: The radar monitors the market in real time. A native Rust WebSocket sidecar streams live ticks from four exchanges and folds candles from one minute up to four hours. The full universe of four thousand four hundred eighty-eight instruments is regularly scanned and scored natively in roughly one hundred fifty milliseconds, with every monetary value stored strictly as fixed-point integers.
